summary: The new FamilySearch/target-only driver is not runnable as written because it calls the stage-2 master with another script’s argument order. Even after fixing that call, the slide-table generator still reads the old all-record ML link, leaving the new target-only result unused. The figure-wrapper comment repair and target-output isolation are sound.

findings.title: The FamilySearch target-only driver calls the stage-2 master with the core matcher’s arguments
findings.what_the_code_does: Line 58 executes `2_ABE_matchingV3_master_christian_torben.do 1930 1940 "_fs_cleaned" 1 "_tgt_cleaned"`. The master interprets those positions as year list, interval, location, FamilySearch years, and FamilySearch type, respectively; thus it receives interval 1940 and location `_fs_cleaned`. The five supplied arguments instead match the signature of the non-master `2_ABE_matchingV3_christian_torben.do`, where they mean year 1, year 2, type A, location, and type B.
findings.why_it_matters: The driver fails before creating `r_fs_cleaned_tgt_cleaned1930_1940`, so the intended target-only mixed link file and its slide result cannot be produced.
findings.how_to_check: Run `powershell -File replication/Run-Stata.ps1 MATCHING/_fs_tgt_run.do`; the log should stop at the stage-2 call and never print `FS-TGT-DONE`. The mismatch is also visible with `rg -n '^local (yr_list|interval|location|fs_years|fstype|ml_years)|2_ABE_matchingV3' MATCHING/_fs_tgt_run.do MATCHING/2_ABE_matchingV3_master_christian_torben.do MATCHING/2_ABE_matchingV3_christian_torben.do`.
findings.suggested_fix: At line 58, call `2_ABE_matchingV3_christian_torben.do` rather than its master, retaining the five existing arguments. Alternatively, extend the master with an explicit `mltype` argument and invoke it using its actual year-list/interval/location signature.

findings.title: The slide-table generator still reads the all-record ML link, leaving the new target-only link unused
findings.what_the_code_does: The new driver is intended to write `link1930_1940_fs1930_mltgt1940_cleaned_noraceblock0.dta`, but slide mode defines `f_fs30ml` as `link1930_1940_fs1930_ml1940_cleaned_noraceblock0.dta` and adds only that old `fs30ml` combination. No table-generating code references the new `mltgt` stem.
findings.why_it_matters: Any slide table regenerated through the documented `do MATCHING/fs_avg_performance.do slides` path continues to report the all-record ML-1940 linkage and agreement rates, not the intended target-only rates.
findings.how_to_check: Run `rg -n 'fs1930_ml(tgt)?1940|f_fs30ml' MATCHING/_fs_tgt_run.do MATCHING/fs_avg_performance.do`; the target-only filename appears only in the driver, while the slide generator points to the old file.
findings.suggested_fix: In slide mode, point the mixed column to the `fs1930_mltgt1940` file, or add it as a separately named combination if both versions are required. Label it explicitly as target-only and regenerate `MATCHING/results/fs_avg_performance_slides.tex`.

verified_clean.item: The repaired figure wrapper no longer contains the nested-comment trap.
verified_clean.evidence: Every header comment is closed on its own line and the prose contains no literal nested `/*` opener at MATCHING/_figs_tgt_run.do:1-11; the file has equal opening and closing comment delimiters.

verified_clean.item: The figure wrapper clears its global and propagates failures.
verified_clean.evidence: MATCHING/_figs_tgt_run.do:14-22 sets `FIG_NEWLINKS`, captures both called scripts, stores `_rc`, clears the global, prints the completion marker, and exits with the stored code.

verified_clean.item: Target-only figure outputs are isolated from default paper outputs.
verified_clean.evidence: The target branch sets `sfx` to `_tgt` at CODE/create_figures_SSHA2025.do:32-45. The temporary dataset, LaTeX table, GPH files, PDFs, log, and repnum file all incorporate that suffix at CODE/create_figures_SSHA2025.do:46,119,158,275-302,361,420-427; CODE/compute_legibility_quartiles.do:19-36 likewise uses the suffixed input and output.

verified_clean.item: The mixed-link stage-3 arguments and expected output filename are internally consistent.
verified_clean.evidence: MATCHING/_fs_tgt_run.do:60-62 passes FamilySearch 1930, target-only ML 1940, and confirms the corresponding output; MATCHING/3_append_and_clean_all_links_christian_torbenV2.do:78-91,149-150 derives the same folder and filename stem.

verified_clean.item: The new mixed-link driver protects existing final and stage-2 outputs from replacement.
verified_clean.evidence: MATCHING/_fs_tgt_run.do:30-39 stops if either the final link file or `r_fs_cleaned_tgt_cleaned1930_1940` already exists.

verified_clean.item: The linkage-rate comparison uses a fixed 1940 master denominator and excludes missing ages.
verified_clean.evidence: MATCHING/fs_avg_performance.do:79-97 constructs one master sample with `age>=10 & age<.` and left-style `keep(1 3)` merges each method into it; rates are then summarized over that common population at lines 110-124.
MATCHING/fs_avg_performance.do:98 and 105 require both initials to be nonempty before comparing them.

review_limits: No paper draft or slide source was supplied, so claims-vs-code could not be checked against manuscript or presentation language.
The external census and intermediate datasets were unavailable; input contents, row counts, generated rates, and the reused divided-file parity could not be verified.
The Stata pipeline and user-written `abeclean`/`abematch` commands were not executed. Runtime consequences are inferred from the source-level argument mapping.
The external paper repository referenced by the figure code was outside the review target, so any manual slide wiring could not be inspected.
